label: V1 Normal
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: WeChat mini program membership level banner background, physical premium membership card / bank card style
Primary request: Create a realistic horizontal premium membership card face, like a luxury bank card or private club member card. The card itself must be clearly visible with rounded rectangle card boundaries, subtle thickness, beveled edge, embossed decorative pattern, metallic chip area, fine guilloche lines, and premium material texture. This is a background asset for native UI text overlay.
Composition/framing: 16:9 horizontal single card centered, slight perspective but not distorted, full card visible with generous margins, left third must be darker and clean for overlaid native Chinese text, decorative emblem and richer detail on right third.
Lighting/mood: premium studio lighting, elegant reflections, tactile material, not a flat wallpaper.
Text: no text, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese characters, no logos, no watermark.
Constraints: no readable text anywhere; no mockup UI; no phone frame; no app screenshot; no grayscale-only requirement; maintain distinct tier identity; avoid abstract background-only image; must look like a physical card.
Avoid: text, digits, brand marks, QR code, barcode, human figures, busy central text area, square crop, vertical card, plain abstract wallpaper.
Tier-specific visual direction: entry level black and pearl-white membership card, matte black left area, pearl enamel right side, simple silver trim, modest chip, understated clean luxury, least ornate.
